meaning: Reviewed Denver pilot trips between public landmarks and public office addresses only (roadmap section 16: no personal home or work addresses). Coordinates are approximate landmark points; the routing engine snaps them to the nearest drivable road and the response discloses the snap distance. Expected values describe the service boundary and legality checks, never a camera count: counts change with every published snapshot.
